description: This file defines a Java interface CommandResponseRegistry, which extends JsonParsableRegistry with a generic type parameter. It serves as a registry for CommandResponse objects, allowing them to be parsed from JSON objects. The interface is designed to be implemented by classes managing sets of command response objects within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: CommandResponseRegistry
classes.description: A registry interface for CommandResponse objects that can parse responses from JSON objects. It is parameterized by the type of CommandResponse it manages.

methods.name: CommandResponseRegistry
methods.description: Interface declaration, extending JsonParsableRegistry with a generic type parameter for CommandResponse.
